settings.repere: Intertitre · What are beef liver capsules?
settings.text: What are beef liver capsules?

settings.repere: Texte · Beef liver capsules are simply gelatin…
settings.text: Beef liver capsules are simply gelatin capsules containing dried beef liver and nothing else. The dried liver is milled into a powder and served in a capsule for maximum convenience to avoid the smell and taste of beef liver. Our beef liver capsules only contain two ingredients, the capsule and the beef liver powder - no fillers or flow agents.

settings.repere: Intertitre · What are the benefits of taking beef l…
settings.text: What are the benefits of taking beef liver capsules?

settings.repere: Texte · The primary benefit is gaining the nut…
settings.text: The primary benefit is gaining the nutritional density of traditional organ meats with ultimate convenience. Our capsules allow you to easily incorporate a natural, whole-food source of Vitamin B12 and retinol (Vitamin A) into your daily routine without the need to source, prepare, or taste fresh liver.

settings.repere: Intertitre · What Nutrients Are Naturally Found in …
settings.text: What Nutrients Are Naturally Found in Beef Liver?

settings.repere: Texte · Beef liver is naturally rich in Vitami…
settings.text: Beef liver is naturally rich in Vitamin B12 and a good source of preformed Vitamin A (retinol). Our gentle drying process ensures these nutrients remain intact and bioavailable.

settings.repere: Intertitre · Do beef liver capsules have a strong t…
settings.text: Do beef liver capsules have a strong taste or smell?

settings.repere: Texte · No. Our beef liver capsules are comple…
settings.text: No. Our beef liver capsules are completely tasteless and odourless. They provide a convenient way to consume nutrient-dense organ meats without the strong flavour, texture, or preparation required for fresh liver.

settings.repere: Intertitre · How Does Beef Liver Taste?
settings.text: How Does Beef Liver Taste?

settings.repere: Texte · Freeze dried beef liver is available i…
settings.text: Freeze dried beef liver is available in both capsule and powder form, and the taste experience can vary depending on which you choose.

settings.text: Most people find beef spleen capsules virtually tasteless. They’re an easy and convenient way to get the benefits of organ meats without the flavour.

settings.repere: Texte · Freeze-dried beef spleen powder has a …
settings.text: Freeze-dried beef spleen powder has a rich, earthy flavour that’s true to its natural source. While some people enjoy the taste in savoury blends, others prefer to mix it into smoothies, broths, or sauces to mask the flavour.

settings.repere: Texte · Whether you choose capsules or powder,…
settings.text: Whether you choose capsules or powder, beef spleen is valued more for its nutrient density than its taste. Tip: If you're sensitive to taste or short on time, capsules are the most neutral option.

settings.text: As a food, beef liver can be consumed at any time of day, but many people prefer to consume in the morning as part of their daily routine.

settings.repere: Intertitre · Are Your Products Certified Organic?
settings.text: Are Your Products Certified Organic?

settings.repere: Texte · While we source our organs exclusively…
settings.text: While we source our organs exclusively from pristine, pasture-raised cattle in Tasmania, we do not rely on "certified organic" labels. Here is why:

settings.repere: Texte · Organic certification is a promise abo…
settings.text: Organic certification is a promise about how the farm is managed, but it does not guarantee that the final capsule is actually free from environmental contaminants. We prefer proof over promises.

settings.repere: Texte · Instead of paying for an organic logo,…
settings.text: Instead of paying for an organic logo, we invest in rigorous, independent lab testing. We screen our finished products using state-of-the-art ICP-MS technology to test for 32 heavy metals (like Lead and Mercury) and agricultural chemicals (like Glyphosate) to guarantee absolute purity.

settings.repere: Intertitre · Can I Consume Beef Liver While Pregnan…
settings.text: Can I Consume Beef Liver While Pregnant?

settings.repere: Texte · Beef liver is naturally rich in nutrie…
settings.text: Beef liver is naturally rich in nutrients like vitamin A, B12, iron, and folate. It's important to consider preformed vitamin A (retinol) intake during this time.

settings.repere: Texte · In Australia, the Recommended Dietary …
settings.text: In Australia, the Recommended Dietary Intake (RDI) for vitamin A during pregnancy is 800 - 1000  µg of retinol equivalents (RE) per day. Our freeze-dried beef liver capsules provide a moderate 240 µg RE per 2g serve — well within recommended daily limits when included as part of a balanced diet.

settings.repere: Texte · Even so, we recommend speaking with yo…
settings.text: Even so, we recommend speaking with your healthcare provider before consuming beef liver during pregnancy to ensure they align with your personal nutrient needs.

settings.repere: Texte · As with all pregnancies, it’s always b…
settings.text: As with all pregnancies, it’s always best to check with your practitioner first.
